title: When Ignorance Is Not Bliss: An Empirical Analysis of Subtier Supply Network Structure on Firm Risk
authors: Yixin Wang; Jun Li; Di Wu; Ravi Anupindi
main_or_robustness: main (firm-quarter FE panel with continuous network measures; CAR event study)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables on total, idiosyncratic and industry risk (Eqs. 2-3)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: firm and quarter FE regressions of volatility on continuous network measures (spt2_vol, t2_sharing and interaction) with time-varying controls; continuous regressors, no binary staggered treatment

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 6-7 (abnormal returns around tier-2 supplier risk events)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: short-window CAR event study; not DiD

eligible_reason: Not a binary staggered design. Firm-quarter panel regressions with firm and quarter FE relate firm risk to continuous supply-network measures (tier-2 sharing) and many time-varying controls; causal evidence comes from a CAR event study around tier-2 supplier risk events.
design_notes: Driscoll-Kraay SEs. Package holds only the LaTeX manuscript source and table .tex files.
estimators_reported: firm and quarter FE panel OLS (continuous regressors)
data_files_note: Archive contains only LaTeX source (tex/, Table/*.tex); no code or data. FactSet Revere supply-chain data and Compustat are licensed.
data_provenance_note: No data or code in archive.
screener_notes: Published text and tex source confirm design. Not a near miss (continuous treatment, not a controls-only violation).
